title: Counting Months Already Deferred on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Account
content:
*Hardship accounting note, Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing.*

For a hardship request on an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the months already deferred are counted according to the account's hardship history: an account carrying approved natural-disaster hardship requests counts every deferred month except the months asked on those natural-disaster requests; an account with none and funded at least sixty months before the request counts only the months deferred in the thirty-six months before the request; every other account counts every deferred month.

## Terms used

- **Deferred months**: the months on the hardship deferrals booked on the financing account, each deferral counted by the consecutive months it covers and dated the day it was granted.
- **Months asked on natural-disaster requests**: the months requested on the account's hardship requests whose reason is a natural disaster and whose status is approved.
- **Funded at least sixty months before the request**: sixty or more months from the funded date to the request.

## Counting method

| Approved natural-disaster request on the account | Funded at least 60 months before the request | Months already deferred |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | Every deferred month, less the months asked on those natural-disaster requests |
| No | Yes | Only the months deferred in the 36 months before the request |
| No | No | Every deferred month |

## Hypothetical histories

| History | Months already deferred |
|---|---|
| Deferrals of 3 months (granted 40 months ago) and 2 months (granted 10 months ago); funded 70 months ago; no natural-disaster request | 2 (only the deferral granted within the 36 months) |
| The same deferrals, funded 50 months ago, no natural-disaster request | 5 |
| The same deferrals; the 3-month deferral answered an approved natural-disaster request asking 3 months | 5 less 3, or 2 |
| No deferral at all | 0 |
